agent.finish_summary: Fixed the reindent regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py: the condition in _split_kwds() that decides whether to insert a newline before split keywords (FROM, JOIN, AND, OR, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, UNION, VALUES, SET, BETWEEN, EXCEPT, HAVING, LIMIT) was inverted. It read `if (uprev.endswith('\n') or uprev.endswith('\r')):` which only added a newline when one already existed, instead of when one was missing. Changed to `if not (uprev.endswith('\n') or uprev.endswith('\r')):` so a newline is inserted before these keywords when the preceding text doesn't already end in one. Verified with manual tests covering simple keyword splits, BETWEEN/AND, parenthesized subqueries, UNION, VALUES, GROUP BY/HAVING, ORDER BY with identifier lists, and comments — all now reindent correctly, matching the expected behavior described in the bug report.
